title: Motion Reel 2026 — 'Every frame on purpose' (code-made résumé reel)
summary: A sibling of 01: a 15 s code-rendered motion résumé on a 128 BPM bar grid. A red dot splits into orbiting dots, a circle iris reveals EVERY FRAME ON PURPOSE in heavy caps (with a framing bracket that snaps around FRAME), then a rounded square with selection handles, a spirograph flower, a dot-grid wave, a blue particle torus, a striped ribbon drawing a loop on yellow, a skill marquee, a spinning text ring and a serif 'Claude.' end card. Calmer and warmer than 01, with a serif sign-off.
fit_reason: The bracket-snap on a keyword and the serif wordmark end card are classy and reusable for a B2B brand; the abstract colour-field chapters are less relevant to a portal product.

palette.mood: high-contrast flat poster colours with a warm off-white paper end card; subtle grain

typography.display: geometric heavy sans caps (Montserrat Black / Gilroy Heavy look) for EVERY FRAME ON PURPOSE; elegant text serif (Source Serif / Tiempos look) for the 'Claude.' wordmark with a red full stop; spaced bold caps for the marquee; tiny mono HUD
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred words; small letter-spaced caps for the marquee and sub-label 'MOTION DESIGNER'
typography.notes: End card: serif wordmark, red dot as full stop, letter-spaced 'MOTION DESIGNER' and a mono metadata line under it.

text_animation: word revealed inside a growing circle iris (EVERY at 1.9 s)
next word drops in letter by letter on a wave with motion blur (FRAME tilts and settles)
corner-bracket selection box snaps around the key word (FRAME)
letters rise from a baseline mask with blur (Claude at 13.5 s), red dot lands as the full stop
marquee rows of skills scrolling at different speeds
text on a spinning circle path (MOTION DESIGN ANIMATION ART DIRECTION)
motion: rounded square rotating with Figma-style selection handles and a 'ROT 101.4°' label
dot grid deforming into a 3D wave
striped ribbon drawing a loop with ease-in-out
transitions: circle iris grow/shrink between colour fields (1.9 s, 13.2 s)
hard cut on the bar (every 1.875 s at 128 BPM)
graphic_elements: HUD: 'MOTION REEL 2026' top-left, 'BAR 2/8 · 128 BPM' top-right, frame counter + timecode bottom-right, corner marks
ui_treatment: none (design-tool selection handles are the only UI nod)
signature_moves: corner-bracket box snapping around the key word
serif wordmark end card with a red-dot full stop
HUD with BAR n/8 and BPM

best_segments.what: Iris reveals EVERY, FRAME waves in and gets bracketed, ON PURPOSE lands; then rounded square with selection handles.
Skill marquee, spinning text rings, iris to off-white, serif 'Claude.' rises from a mask and the red dot lands as the full stop.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP on a 128 BPM timeline: SVG circle clip-path for the iris, SplitText chars with stagger + blur for the wave, four absolutely positioned corner brackets animated to the word's bounding box, SVG textPath on circles for the rings, canvas for dot fields.
recreate.prompt: 15 s motion reel on a 128 BPM grid with a thin HUD ('BAR 2/8 · 128 BPM'). Near-black #111113, red #ec4134, blue #313cf5, yellow #f4cb42 and paper #ece6df chapters. Heavy geometric caps 'EVERY FRAME ON PURPOSE' revealed by a circle iris, with corner brackets snapping around FRAME; end on a serif wordmark whose red dot drops in as the full stop.
